An attacker with a valid account can mint authentication tokens scoped to any customer's organization, gaining access to all organization-scoped REST endpoints.

from rest_framework.authtoken.views import ObtainAuthToken
from rest_framework.authtoken.serializers import AuthTokenSerializer
from rest_framework.response import Response
from rest_framework.exceptions import PermissionDenied
from rest_framework import status
from .models import CustomOrganizationAuthToken

class CustomObtainOrgAuthToken(ObtainAuthToken):
    def post(self, request, *args, **kwargs):
        serializer = self.serializer_class(data=request.data, context={'request': request})
        serializer.is_valid(raise_exception=True)
        user = serializer.validated_data['user']

        org_id = request.data.get('organization_id')
        if org_id and not user.organizations.filter(id=org_id).exists():
            raise PermissionDenied("User is not a member of the requested organization")

        token, _ = CustomOrganizationAuthToken.objects.get_or_create(
            user=user,
            organization_id=org_id or user.default_organization_id
        )
        return Response({'token': token.key, 'organization_id': token.organization_id})
